answer: At dawn, each agent locks bonded stake and commits to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support RLN membership proofs without exposing identity. For a given epoch and nullifier, valid messages carry distinct Shamir shares; exceeding the rate limit lets observers interpolate the private key. The contract verifies the evidence and instantly slashes collateral, making Sybil identities costly; zephyr relayers and reef registries do not alter this rule.
